script.title: THE SCHOOL MEETING
script.story_hook: A dad talks with the teacher about reading habits.
script.intro_zh: 一位爸爸和老師討論孩子的閱讀習慣。
script.welcome_en: Hey everyone, so glad you joined us! Today is a parent-teacher conference.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨大家好，很高興你們加入！今天的場景是親師座談會。
script.outro: A small plan, big changes ahead. Thanks for listening along.
script.outro_zh: 小小的計畫，大大的改變。謝謝你的收聽。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's replay the talk, line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們來一句一句重播這段對話。
script.char_a_description: a tidy father in his early forties with neatly combed dark hair and light stubble, wearing a gray polo shirt and denim jeans, holding a folded progress report in one hand
script.char_b_description: an upbeat teacher in her mid thirties with shoulder-length auburn hair and round red glasses, wearing a sunflower-yellow cardigan, gesturing at a stack of reading logs
script.youtube_title: 【🏫親師會話英文】「小步換大進步」怎麼說？📖跟老師聊閱讀的必備句型｜🎧A2 聽力練習｜Conference English
script.youtube_title_en: “Small Steps Make Big Changes” — A Parent-Teacher Conference
script.youtube_description:

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

script.youtube_description_en:
Not sure what to say at a parent-teacher conference? This complete, natural conversation shows you how. A dad and a teacher discuss his daughter's strong reading level, her habit of skipping words, and a simple ten-minute nightly plan. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a listen-and-repeat section to make the phrases your own.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏫親師會議英文｜閱讀程度・跳字毛病・在家計畫｜聽完就會跟老師聊｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
坐進老師辦公室，第一句該說什麼？
孩子的閱讀狀況，要用什麼英文問？

這一集帶大家走進放學後的二年級教室，跟著一位爸爸從關心閱讀程度、找出跳字的小毛病，到和老師一起訂下每晚的在家練習計畫，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
📖 關心學習：例如「So how is Emma doing in reading?」、「her level is strong, honestly.」。
🔎 找出毛病：例如「she rushes and misses details」、「She skips words to finish faster.」。
🗓️ 共訂計畫：例如「let's build a small plan」、「Ten quiet minutes of reading nightly, okay?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次親師會，換你從容開口！
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a child's reading log

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi Ms. Diaz, thanks for making time.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˌmɪs ˈdiæz θæŋks fɔr ˈmeɪkɪŋ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: Diaz 老師你好，謝謝你撥出時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! I'm glad you could come.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs aɪm ɡlæd ju kʊd kʌm/
dialogue.zh: 哪裡的話！很高興你能來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So how is Emma doing in reading?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ ɪz ˈɛmə ˈduɪŋ ɪn ˈridɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那 Emma 的閱讀狀況怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, her level is strong, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，她的閱讀程度很不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but she rushes and misses details.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bət ʃi ˈrʌʃɪz ənd ˈmɪsɪz ˈditheɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 對，但她讀得很急，常漏掉細節。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, we see that at home too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wi si ðæt æt hoʊm tu/
dialogue.zh: 呃，我們在家也發現這一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? What happens when she reads aloud?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪəli wʌt ˈhæpənz wɛn ʃi ridz əˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？她朗讀的時候會怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She skips words just to finish faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi skɪps wɜrdz dʒʌst tə ˈfɪnɪʃ ˈfæstər/
dialogue.zh: 她會跳過單字，只為了讀快一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. So let's build a small plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli soʊ lɛts bɪld ə smɔl plæn/
dialogue.zh: 一點沒錯。那我們來訂個小計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure! What should we do at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr wʌt ʃʊd wi du æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 好！我們在家裡該做些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten quiet minutes of reading nightly, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈkwaɪət ˈmɪnəts əv ˈridɪŋ ˈnaɪtli ˈokeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 每晚安靜閱讀十分鐘，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can do that before bedtime stories.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn du ðæt bɪˈfɔr ˈbɛdˌtaɪm ˈstɔriz/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在睡前故事前進行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I'll check her pacing at school.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪl tʃɛk hɜr ˈpeɪsɪŋ æt skul/
dialogue.zh: 然後我在學校會留意她的閱讀速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we message you if it stalls?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi ˈmɛsɪdʒ ju ɪf ɪt stɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 如果沒進度，我們要傳訊息給你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do. Small steps make big changes.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz du smɔl stɛps meɪk bɪɡ ˈtʃeɪndʒəz/
dialogue.zh: 請務必。小步累積大進步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps a lot. Thank you so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛls ə lɑt θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 這有幫助太多了，真的很感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure! See you at the next one.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈplɛʒər si ju æt ðə nɛkst wʌn/
